 Order

The instant application under Section 389 read with Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 has been filed by the appellant/applicant seeking the following relief:-
"(i) Allow the present application and suspend the sentence awarded to the appellant and grant bail subject to such conditions as may be deemed just and proper by this Honble Court pending disposal of the main appeal in case FIR No. 194/2017, dated 19.09.2017, PS Sector-3, Chandigarh lodged under Section 120 B r/w 409/420/201 IPC and Sections 8, 9 13(1)(d) r/w Section 13(2) Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988"
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 21/12/2024 at 06:10:25 2.
Heard learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner and perused the contents made in the petition.

Sunita vs Union Territory Chandigarh (State) on 12 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/58359736/
1 3.
Issue notice.
Notice is accepted by learned Additional Public Prosecutors appearing on advance notice on behalf of the respondents.
They prayed for ten days' time to file a Status Report.
Let the same be filed within ten days' as prayed.
4. List on 23rd December, 2024.
CHANDRA DHARI SINGH, J DECEMBER 12, 2024 NA/
